Text: Scouts found a lab for experimental materials on the outskirts of {PlayerSystem}

{D(TechHead)} leads you through the building. “We ran a test according to the manuals,” {he(TechHead)} says and fakes a yawn. “Galileo Institute: they even made experimental tech sound boring.

"The machines are still functional. Have a look at these Nanoweave samples.” 

{D(TechHead)} hands you a grey piece of cloth. It’s remarkably light; slightly rough, but the pattern is too fine to perceive visually.

“Try ripping it in two,” {he(TechHead)} says. It’s impossible.
“They used it for any kind of protection, whether against the environment... or bullets. Only one catch: we’re lacking raw material. But I’ve been investigating.”
Records at the lab mention a stash of raw material on {EnemySystem}

{D(TechHead)} shows you some technical sketches: “This much Nanoweave should be enough for a suit of protective gear, or improved insulation on one of our colonies.”

“And we might be in luck,” {he(TechHead)} continues. “The cache is in a hidden location. According to {SecurityHead}, nobody on {EnemySystem} is even aware of it.”
